fee_notes: Single fee of $24,900 for first franchise (110,000 household territory). Second franchise at 75% of current IFF; third and subsequent at 65%. Veterans receive 10% discount. $5,000 deposit option to reserve territory, credited toward IFF if purchased within 90 days.
raw_excerpt: You must pay to us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") of $24,900 for your first franchise.
